It returned 436 records with zero status=closed while .beads/issues.jsonl holds 2453 records of which 2017 are closed. skills/ac-pipeline-builder/references/board-scan.md Scan A annotates this call '# ALL beads' -- that comment is WRONG for br 0.2.x and is load-bearing: the Tier-1 stale-`unrefined`-on-CLOSED-beads sweep and the Tier-2 positive-proof gate BOTH need closed beads, and both would silently under-count to zero. Every scan tonight was therefore run against issues.jsonl directly. (2) `br sync` in a fresh worktree rebuilds from JSONL and reports 'Created: 2453 issues' while `br list` then shows 436 -- the two numbers are consistent only once (1) is understood. Worth a line in the heartbeat so a future run does not read it as a corrupt import.
